title: Supplier statement of account with no ruled lines
row_rules: Every statement line is a row, including the opening balance brought forward. The Totals line is not a row. Bracketed amounts are negative. A blank debit or credit cell stays blank.
why: The statement has no lines between columns or rows. Details wrap onto a second or third line, every row has either the Debit or the Credit cell empty, and the balance goes negative once, printed in brackets. A text dump split on whitespace turns each wrapped line into a new row and slides credits into the Debit column.
